sections.title: Dilution
sections.excerpt:
DILUTION If you purchase shares of our common stock or pre-funded warrants in this offering, your ownership
interest will be diluted to the extent of the difference between the price per share of our common stock or pre-funded warrant you pay in this offering and the net tangible book value per share of our common
stock immediately after this offering. As of September 30, 2026, we had net tangible book value of approximately $103.1 million, or

sections.title: Dividend Policy
sections.excerpt:
DIVIDEND POLICY We have never declared or paid cash dividends on our capital stock. We currently plan to retain all of our future earnings, if any, to finance
the operation, development and growth of our business. We do not expect to pay any cash dividends on our common stock in the foreseeable future. Payment of future dividends, if any, will be at the discretion of our board of directors and will depend
